subject: QBR prep — Engineered runway, gatekeeping, and launch contingency matrix
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Cho <ryan.cho@partners.dev>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep — Engineered runway, gatekeeping, and launch contingency matrix

Team —

Ahead of next week’s QBR I want a tight readout on the product + eng runway and a concrete gating checklist we can present to the Exec. Goals for this thread:

- Surface any launch timelines at risk (by feature and by milestone).
- Agree on a gatekeeper checklist (safety/perf/ops) and who signs off.
- Produce a short contingency plan (feature cut/prioritization + fallbacks) per high-risk area.

I’ve attached an initial engineered_runway_matrix.xlsx with timeline slices (milestones, owners, risk score). Please review and reply with:
  1) any corrections to owners or milestone dates;
  2) top 3 delivery risks you want on the Exec slide;
  3) one concrete mitigation we can commit to by Friday EOD.

I’ll consolidate and produce a 2-slide summary for the QBR. If we need a short sync, propose 30m windows — I’m blocking 2:30–3pm PT tomorrow.

Thanks,
Karthik
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: engineered_runway_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — Engineered runway, gatekeeping, and launch contingency matrix

On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 09:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Ahead of next week’s QBR I want a tight readout on the product + eng runway and a concrete gating checklist we can present to the Exec.

Thanks Karthik — reading now. High-level from Eng:

- I corrected milestone ownership for the multi-tenant KV cache (#milestone 3). Owner should be Vivek & infra (not Platform PM listed).
- Top 3 risks: 1) model-quantization perf regression on long sequences, 2) autoscaler instability under mixed workloads, 3) rollout validation gaps for private deployments.
- Mitigations I can commit to by Friday EOD: automated perf regression harness (smoke for 3 seq lengths) and a canary window with traffic shaping for Dedicated deploys.

I attached a draft gatekeeper_checklist_v1.pdf with the items I think Engineering must verify before green. It includes mandatory perf SLO checks, KV cache validation, canary thresholds, and rollback criteria.

I’m available for a 30m sync tomorrow at 2:30pm PT.

—Tessa
Director of Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: gatekeeper_checklist_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Cho <ryan.cho@partners.dev>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — Engineered runway, gatekeeping, and launch contingency matrix

Thanks — I reviewed the matrix and made two updates (see tab "Risk Adjustment"). Quick notes:

- Timeline slip: the SDK serialization refactor (milestone 2b) is at risk by 3 weeks due to an integration bug uncovered in the QA pass. Impact: may push staging validation into the same week as the planned canary.
- External dependency: Partners Inc (Ryan) flagged a delayed API contract for metrics ingestion (INF-2748). That could affect our ability to measure canary health in Dedicated.

Top 3 delivery risks for Exec slide (my phrasing):
  1) Validation telemetry blind spots during early canary;
  2) Perf regressions for long-context quantized models;
  3) Coordinated feature rollout across Hosted/Dedicated/Private (sync failure).

Mitigation ask: a short contingency_cut_list.csv attached with prioritized cuts if timelines slip (min viable feature set + owner). Please review and confirm owners.

Laura Bennett
Head of Program Management, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: contingency_cut_list.csv (CSV)]

From: Ryan Cho <ryan.cho@partners.dev>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — Engineered runway, gatekeeping, and launch contingency matrix

Karthik/Laura —

Quick note from Partners Inc operations: the API contract delivery will slip by ~4 business days. We can supply a temporary metrics bridge (ingest proxy) but it requires a small schema mapping change on your side. If Eng can accept a 2-field mapping change, we can ensure canary metrics are intact.

I’ll be on the call tomorrow to walk through the mapping.

—Ryan
Infrastructure Program Lead, Partners Inc
ryan.cho@partners.dev

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ryan Cho <ryan.cho@partners.dev>, support@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep — Engineered runway, gatekeeping, and launch contingency matrix

Thanks all — summary and decisions for the Exec deck: 

1) Risk callouts accepted (Laura/Tessa). I’ll include the three risks on Slide 2 with brief mitigation bullets.
2) Gatekeeper checklist: Eng items (perf harness + canary window) are required for green; Platform/Infra signoff (Vivek + Ryan) required for measurement readiness.
3) Contingency: Laura’s cut list accepted as the prioritized path if SDK refactor slips by >2 weeks. Laura to notify PMs and update ticket owners.
4) Action items (owners & deadlines):
   - Tessa: complete perf regression harness smoke & canary thresholds (Due: Fri 5/7 EOD)
   - Vivek: confirm infra canary behavior + signing criteria (Due: Fri 5/7 noon)
   - Laura: finalize contingency_cut_list.csv and notify PMs (Due: Fri 5/7 3pm)
   - Karthik: produce 2-slide QBR summary and exec talking points (Due: Mon 5/10 9am)

We’ll run a 30m dry-run with Exec comms at 9am PT Monday — calendar invite incoming. If any owner cannot meet the deadline, flag here ASAP so I can adjust the deck.

Karthik
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
[Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QBR-runway-gating-notes | Jira INF-2748]
